summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; permits validator-owned same-selection successor contexts from valid published/LKG catalog using current selected read-set; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes source bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection/current source hashes/snapshot/Locator/decisions/predecessor; authority envelope covers ADRs/rules/policies/contracts/registries/allowed successors; stale freshness or query-quality may allow degraded execution only for unrelated targets with verifiable selection/authority/modules/read-set; publication failure does not advance current/LKG or invalidate valid LKG; integrity, authority, contract, policy, protected-path, command/test, selection, and Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid-evolution excludes Knowledge self-change, publication, lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published Knowledge, publication-quality checks, semantic review; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes ADR-0057 stale-stop interpretation only; publication query gate and LKG integrity remain strict.
